posts.author: auradev
posts.body:
Posting resources I had commissioned with a shareable license for my games. Please keep in mind that I'm just the wallet, credit goes the artist(s) involved in creating the assets. Some resources may depend on DLC like generator part DLC (will be marked in the corresponding resources), so make sure you have that if you want to use the resource in your game.
The resoures are for made for MZ games, but some may involve asset packs from other makers, so likewise make sure you own that.
For characters generated through the RPGMaker char gen, I will try to also attach the generator config to the post if possible.
Note that your generator will need to have the listed Generator Parts setup or it will of course not work.
Terms
Free to use in commercial and non-commercial work.
Credit goes to the artist of the corresponding asset.
Some assets are based on previous work / DLC, make sure you also fulfill their terms.
Editing, reposting and usage in adult content is ok.
Optional: When sharing or reposting edits, a link to this thread would be nice to maintain a traceable chain for the assets.
Regarding Pixel animations: I assume most people have their own workflows. In case you don't here are some options:
Script it directly using movement route script commands
Galv's
MZ Move Route Extras
can be used to play step animations, set frames, etc. making the scripting cleaner
We ended up rolling our own
Pixel Animation Plugin
for better reuse by defining animations in a JSON file.
